evals.prompt: I have eight things open this week and no plan. What should we actually work on?
evals.expected_output: Every task tested against a written mission, top three with owners and dates.
expectations: Writes the mission in one sentence, marked the owner's or proposal
Gives keep, change or stop with a reason on every task
Picks a top three with an owner and a look-again date each
Lists stops as proposals for the owner, not done

evals.prompt: Two sessions both want this week: one on the MLB props idea, one on fixing NHL grading. Which matters more?
evals.expected_output: Tests both against the mission and orders them.
expectations: Tests each task with one question against the mission
Reads other sessions' records without writing them
Orders the two with a one-line reason
Names an owner for the kept task
